name: Mail Agent Evaluation
description: Evaluation dataset for the mail agent covering email search by topic, listing recent emails, finding by sender, summarizing threads, drafting replies, and drafting new emails.

cases.input: Find emails about the Q3 board presentation.
cases.expected_output: The assistant returns at least one email about the Q3 board presentation, including the email from Sarah Connor asking Huy Phan to confirm the AI infrastructure cost for the Q3 board presentation.
retrieval_context:
From: sarah.connor@workspace.com
To: huy.phan@workspace.com
Subject: Q3 Board Presentation — AI Infrastructure Cost
Date: Monday
Body: Hi Huy, could you confirm the AI infrastructure cost for Q3 so I can include it in the board presentation? Also, do you have a breakdown of usage by agent type? Thanks, Sarah.

cases.input: Show me recent emails from Alice Nguyen.
cases.expected_output: The assistant lists recent emails from Alice Nguyen, including the email about the landing page copy review and the one about the August content calendar.
retrieval_context:
From: alice.nguyen-{orgSlug}@example.com
To: huy.phan@workspace.com
Subject: Landing Page Copy — Staging Review
Date: Tuesday
Body: Hi Huy, the new landing page copy is live on staging. Could you take a look and let me know your thoughts? Particularly the hero headline and CTA. Thanks, Alice.

From: alice.nguyen-{orgSlug}@example.com
To: huy.phan@workspace.com
Subject: August Content Calendar Published
Date: Wednesday
Body: Hi team, the August content calendar is now published. We have 3 blog posts, 12 social posts, and 1 press release draft scheduled. Let me know if anything needs adjusting. Alice.

cases.expected_output: The assistant returns the email from Michael Torres at michael.torres@novatech.io regarding the NovaTech testimonial permission.
retrieval_context:
From: michael.torres@novatech.io
To: huy.phan@workspace.com
Subject: Testimonial Permission — NovaTech Solutions
Date: Thursday
Body: Hi Huy, happy to grant permission to use the NovaTech testimonial on your landing page: 'Serenity cut our meeting overhead by 40%. We ship twice as fast.' Feel free to attribute it to me with my name and title. Best, Michael Torres, Head of Engineering, NovaTech Solutions.

cases.input: Summarize the email thread about the Redis graceful fallback PR.
cases.expected_output: The thread started with Huy Phan requesting a review of PR #52 (Redis session layer). Bob Chen reviewed and found that the error path when Redis goes down threw a 500 error instead of degrading gracefully. Huy updated the code to fall back to the Prisma session store with a warning log. Bob then asked to verify the health endpoint reports degraded mode. Huy added a degraded status response. Bob approved and merged the PR.
retrieval_context:
From: huy.phan@workspace.com
To: bob.chen-{orgSlug}@example.com
Subject: PR #52 — Redis Session Layer — Review Request
Date: Monday
Body: Hey Bob, PR #52 is up for the Redis session layer implementation. Would appreciate a second pair of eyes. Thanks.

From: bob.chen-{orgSlug}@example.com
To: huy.phan@workspace.com
Subject: Re: PR #52 — Redis Session Layer — Review Request
Date: Monday
Body: Reviewing now. One issue: the error path when Redis goes down throws a 500. It should degrade gracefully to the DB session store instead.

From: huy.phan@workspace.com
To: bob.chen-{orgSlug}@example.com
Subject: Re: PR #52 — Redis Session Layer — Review Request
Date: Monday
Body: Updated. Redis failure now falls back to Prisma session store with a warning log.

From: bob.chen-{orgSlug}@example.com
To: huy.phan@workspace.com
Subject: Re: PR #52 — Redis Session Layer — Review Request
Date: Monday
Body: Looks good. One last thing — does the health endpoint report degraded mode?

From: huy.phan@workspace.com
To: bob.chen-{orgSlug}@example.com
Subject: Re: PR #52 — Redis Session Layer — Review Request
Date: Monday
Body: Added. Response is: {"status":"degraded","redis":"unavailable","session":"db-fallback"}

From: bob.chen-{orgSlug}@example.com
To: huy.phan@workspace.com
Subject: Re: PR #52 — Redis Session Layer — Review Request
Date: Monday
Body: Approved and merged. Graceful degradation should apply to all Redis-dependent paths going forward.
